name: probot-repo-configurator
description: GitHub App for automatic repository configuration using Probot

scripts.deploy:heroku: echo "Deploying to Heroku..." && git push heroku main
scripts.deploy:docker: docker build -t probot-repo-configurator . && docker push probot-repo-configurator
scripts.deploy:server: pm2 restart probot-repo-configurator || pm2 start index.js --name probot-repo-configurator

author: pulseengine
